name: Jeylione Bonne
source:
Commander of the Kingdom of Orcrecia and the Knights of Incense Swords. He performs a wide range of tasks, from missions related to star spirits to training members.

He is sincere and has a strong sense of justice. He overwhelms his opponents with his skillful swordsmanship.

[Translated from [url=http://comodo.starfree.jp/perfumer/chara.html]official website[/url]]
